To manage computational requirements and reduce transient simulation time for long charge–discharge cycles, the heat transfer fluids (HTFs) in the charge and discharge tubes were not explicitly modeled within the CFD domain. Instead, their effects were incorporated through a custom reduced-order model that applies one-dimensional transient energy balances and established convective heat transfer correlations for turbulent tube flow.
